title: Restricted Reference-ET No-Interception Potential-Transpiration Producer
purpose: Produce the current root-uptake ET result for the source-bound B1.10 SWETR=1, SWMETDETAIL=0, SWINTER=0 route without migrating Penman-Monteith, interception, weather-file I/O, calendar scheduling or persistent meteo globals.

legacy_regions.weather_ETref_units: SWAP_4.3.1/cases/4.salinitystress/tools/template/weather/235.met header: ETref reference evapotranspiration in mm

admitted_legacy_route.reference_et_source: explicit current forcing value in mm per day

source_reduction.inactive_crop: 0 exactly, without consulting stale ET/canopy factors

time_contract.qualified_source_route: B1.10 SWETR=1 supplies daily ETref, but this producer consumes the selected rate and does not encode a one-day timestep

validation: active reference_et_mm_per_day must be finite and nonnegative
active vegetation_cover_fraction must be finite and within [0,1]
active crop_factor must be finite and nonnegative
active CO2_transpiration_factor must be finite and nonnegative
derived potential_transpiration must be finite and nonnegative
inactive crop returns canonical zero without consulting stale active-route values
forbidden: SWINTER=1, SWINTER=2 or SWINTER=3 interception physics
soil evaporation, pond evaporation or precipitation processing
weather-file parsing, record cursors or calendar lookup
persistent ptra, ptra_dry, ptra_wet, wfrac or aintc state
moving potential_transpiration into committed crop-root state
qualification_tests: active source-bound formula against independent B1.10 oracle
